Steward capability confirmed: Steward owner/admin manages business membership and module roles; listModuleRoles and role events are available.
Remaining gap: The SDK exposes no module call to invite staff or programmatically grant/revoke module roles.
Required decision or contract: Use Steward owner/admin UI for membership and role assignment; confirm the operating runbook.
Safe interim approach: Organisation Admin completes staff setup in Steward before HireScope creates an interviewer task or assignment.
Impact: Manual prerequisite for staff/interviewer activation; not a HireScope code blocker.

Required HireScope capability: HR approval routing for requisitions and openings
Steward capability confirmed: Custom proposals, proposal plans, task.create, askPerson, and decision/answer events are documented.
Remaining gap: No core API changes HireScope requisition/opening state automatically; that is the expected module boundary.
Required decision or contract: Register proposal/ask kinds, correlation and idempotency keys, and an accepted-decision handler in HireScope.
Safe interim approach: Use the accepted proposal or ask response as the authoritative trigger for the HireScope transition.
Impact: Implementable now; not an SDK gap.

Required HireScope capability: Candidate outbound email and delivery tracking
Steward capability confirmed: createMessage drafts an outside-contact message for approval; getMessage reports sent/discarded. notifyMember is for internal staff only.
Remaining gap: No documented arbitrary-recipient send, attachment behaviour, or message-delivery webhook.
Required decision or contract: Confirm applicant contact/channel creation, permitted content/link policy, attachment handling, and polling/event strategy.
Safe interim approach: Create an approved candidate contact/channel and use an approved Steward draft; handle attachments outside the message body.
Impact: Blocks fully automated candidate delivery until the contact/channel policy is agreed.

Steward capability confirmed: fileRecord can seal a signed PDF/hash; Steward can draft the offer email.
Remaining gap: No native offer, e-signature, candidate acceptance, or offer-expiry operation.
Required decision or contract: Choose an approved e-sign/acceptance provider and define the signed callback/result contract.
Safe interim approach: Record a human-verified external acceptance/decline reference; never infer acceptance from email delivery.

Steward capability confirmed: task.create, proposal plans, and task status operations support internal onboarding coordination; callModule supports owner-accepted id-only operations.
Remaining gap: No named onboarding operation or accepted/completed/failed/cancelled event schema is documented.
Required decision or contract: Define an external/onboarding-module operation, states, idempotency, and callback/event contract.
Safe interim approach: Keep the onboarding case in HireScope and linked work in Steward; record the external reference manually.
Impact: Blocks automated handoff/status synchronisation, not task coordination.

Steward capability confirmed: People, units, and reporting lines are readable; signed records and deletion receipts are supported.
Remaining gap: No employee profile, employment, document, or lifecycle write operation is documented.
Required decision or contract: Set a field-level source-of-truth map; add an employee API only if Steward should own those fields.
Safe interim approach: HireScope keeps only approved limited employee fields with provenance; avoid bidirectional sync.
Impact: Required for the limited employee-record scope.

Steward capability confirmed: getFreeBusy reads authorised availability; Steward tasks and notices coordinate participants.
Remaining gap: No calendar-event creation, RSVP, meeting-link, or conferencing write operation is documented.
Required decision or contract: Choose an approved scheduler/conferencing provider and define its integration contract.
Safe interim approach: Record the schedule in HireScope and send approved Steward messages; do not claim a calendar booking exists.

Steward capability confirmed: completeAi and sendOutside are available; an outside service must be declared and used under Steward's grant rules. Video is out of scope.
Remaining gap: No assessment delivery, secure upload, transcription, audio retention, or media-deletion API is documented.
Required decision or contract: Approve an audio/media processor, consent, retention/deletion rules, evidence IDs, and failure handling.
Safe interim approach: Use HireScope-controlled secure audio storage and worker only after privacy/legal approval.
Impact: Blocks automated audio/media processing; not text assessment delivery.

Required HireScope capability: Applicant access to application and assessment
Steward capability confirmed: Steward provides an external sign-in client and scoped guest-key patterns for outside people.
Remaining gap: No HireScope applicant-account/application/assessment data model is defined by Steward.
Required decision or contract: Choose standard external sign-in versus a scoped guest model and document the privacy/access boundaries.
Safe interim approach: Do not repurpose a guest key until the chosen model and scope are approved.

Steward capability confirmed: Board posts are informational; tasks and messages can coordinate publication work.
Remaining gap: No careers-site, LinkedIn, or job-board publishing API is documented.
Required decision or contract: Choose an owned connector or approved external job-board/ATS provider.
Safe interim approach: Publish on the HireScope careers page and record manual external-posting references.

Required HireScope capability: Recruitment record retention, legal hold, and purge
Steward capability confirmed: createAudit, fileRecord, and createDeletionReceipt are supported. A business legal hold can defer Steward deletion instructions.
Remaining gap: No record-level legal-hold or retention API governs HireScope-owned recruitment data.
Required decision or contract: Define record-class ownership, retention schedule, hold checks, deletion evidence, and policy responsibilities.
Safe interim approach: HireScope enforces its own retention/hold rules and emits a Steward deletion receipt when required.
Impact: Compliance risk if record ownership remains undefined.

Steward capability confirmed: Documented events include task.changed, proposal/plan decisions, ask answers, role changes, module roles, guest events, and module lifecycle.
Remaining gap: No documented event for message delivery, staff invitation, offer response, onboarding, calendar, or employee update.
Required decision or contract: Use documented events where present; specify polling/callback correlation, retries, ordering, and idempotency for the rest.
Safe interim approach: Poll getMessage for outbound status and reconcile approved provider callbacks by correlation ID.
Impact: Prevents reliable event-driven synchronisation for unsupported lifecycle events.

Steward capability confirmed: sendOutside can use a declared external service under its grant rules; createAudit records the workflow trail.
Remaining gap: No SpringVerify endpoint, authentication, consent fields, callback, result schema, or adverse-result flow is supplied.
Required decision or contract: Confirm SpringVerify API, data-processing terms, consent/notice, grant eligibility, callback security, retries, retention, and HR-only decision process.
Safe interim approach: HR records externally completed verification evidence; provider outcome never auto-decides.
